selected_problem: Fresh canonical-main inspection found an executable-winner integrity defect inside the unresolved native complex changeset synthesis path: selectFederatedProposal reported validCount=0 when every candidate lacked the required changes+validation evidence, but still fell back to ranked[0] as winner. NorthStarRunner.synthesize only rejected a missing proposal or empty changes, so a code-only candidate with no validation commands could reach transactional staging even though the federation itself classified it as non-executable.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The fresh defect is a singular, central, directly reproduced, evidence-rich integrity bottleneck; the checked-in four-mode router's deterministic narrow-bottleneck gate therefore routes DEEP_DEVELOPMENT.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. The committed DWAC North Star and four-mode router source contracts were replayed against fresh canonical code evidence after the hosted Developer Execution Runtime returned transient HTTP 502.

pre_fix_reproduction.scenario: all federation candidates are non-executable because they lack validation evidence
pre_fix_reproduction.observed_on_canonical_base: validCount=0 but winner was the highest-ranked non-executable candidate

changes: Federation winner selection now fails closed: if no candidate contains normalized repository changes, at least one validation command, and no ambiguous path, winner is null instead of ranked[0].
The existing NorthStarRunner unresolved-cognition path can therefore stop at WAITING_PROVIDER rather than staging a candidate that federation itself considers non-executable.

Selection protocol advances from taowind.federated-changeset-selection.v0.7 to v0.8; scoring, consensus, context recovery, RCL authority, transactional staging, validation, rollback and GitHub delivery boundaries remain unchanged.
truth_boundaries: Arbitrary complex repository semantic synthesis remains UNRESOLVED. This cycle only closes the escape hatch that could label a non-executable candidate as the federation winner.
Filesystem crash-level atomicity for arbitrary I/O or process failure remains unresolved.
No new model, provider, product form, interface shape, feature roadmap or hard-coded task-to-mode mapping was introduced.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
